entries.name: Banner of Truth
entries.doctrinal_basis: Calvinistic evangelical; reprints Puritan and Reformed authors.
points_to_weigh: Not tied to one denomination; authors span Presbyterian, Baptist and Anglican Puritans.
entries.description: Publisher founded in 1957, known for reprints of Puritan and Reformed classics and new works in the same tradition.

entries.name: P&R Publishing
entries.doctrinal_basis: Publishes according to the Westminster Confession of Faith.
entries.description: Publisher founded in 1930 that states it publishes in accordance with the Westminster Confession; long associated with Westminster Theological Seminary.

entries.description: Publisher founded in 1994 by Joel Beeke; reprints Puritan and Reformed works and publishes new titles, each reviewed by Beeke.

entries.name: Christian Focus Publications
entries.doctrinal_basis: Evangelical, Reformed-leaning; children's list is widely used in Reformed families.
points_to_weigh: Doctrinal statement is broadly evangelical rather than confessional; check individual titles.
entries.description: Publisher begun in the early 1970s; imprints include Christian Focus, CF4K (children), Christian Heritage and Mentor (academic).

entries.name: Reformation Trust
entries.doctrinal_basis: Ligonier affirms the Westminster Standards, Three Forms of Unity and 1689 Baptist Confession as consistent with its teaching.
points_to_weigh: Ligonier is multi-denominational; authors include paedobaptists and credobaptists.
entries.description: Publishing arm of Ligonier Ministries, publishing R. C. Sproul and others.

entries.name: Reformed Free Publishing Association
entries.doctrinal_basis: Publishes for the Protestant Reformed Churches.
points_to_weigh: The Protestant Reformed Churches reject common grace and the well-meant offer of the gospel; other Reformed bodies dispute these positions. Read titles knowing this.
entries.description: Publisher founded in 1924 and tied to the Protestant Reformed Churches.
